QUOTE: An unknown top-level section is refused by name. Only keys prefixed `x-` are tolerated and ignored, so newer experimental keys do not break older clew builds.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says unknown sections are refused by name, but it doesn't mention the allowed set. It also doesn't give the reason, which is that an ignored section would build with defaults while reporting the declaration was honoured.
